title.zh: Clash Verge Rev 扩展配置脚本（Script/Merge）进阶：自动化规则追加与第三方规则集整合
title.en: Clash Verge Rev Script & Merge Extensibility: Automated Rule Preprocessing & Third-Party Rule-Set Integration

description.zh: 探索 Clash Verge Rev 的扩展配置（Merge 与 JavaScript Script）高级特性。教你如何用代码在机场订阅更新时自动追加自定义分流规则、注入企业级 DNS、重写策略组并无缝集成 Loyalsoldier 等第三方规则集。
description.en: Master advanced profile preprocessing in Clash Verge Rev using YAML Merge and JavaScript extension scripts. Learn how to automatically inject custom proxy groups, DNS servers, and third-party rule providers upon subscription refresh.
